svg.title: Move a window, then move on
svg.desc: Three illustrated steps show a four-finger swipe moving the focused window to the adjacent workspace, followed by a three-finger swipe to continue to another workspace. The moved window remains on its destination workspace.
svg.text: WINDOW GESTURES REVIVED · THE WORKSPACE FLOW
Move a window, then move on
Send the focused window to the next workspace. Keep navigating at your own pace.

g.text: Start a four-finger swipe across the touchpad.
Move the focused window toward its neighbor.
Release to finish the move to an adjacent workspace.
The focused window is now on Workspace 3.
Use three fingers to switch workspaces independently.
Keep moving. Your window is where you left it.

svg.text: Illustration of the default workflow. The extension moves the window one adjacent workspace per four-finger gesture.
Window Gestures Revived · GNOME Shell extension · GNOME 51 Shell-style illustration, not a captured screenshot
